alb_dns_name.description: Public DNS name of the Application Load Balancer — open in a browser to hit the app.

db_master_user_secret_arn.description: Secrets Manager ARN holding the auto-generated RDS master password.

github_actions_role_arn.description: Role ARN to configure as role-to-assume in GitHub Actions (OIDC, no long-lived keys).

sns_topic_arn.description: SNS topic ARN that CloudWatch alarms notify (null if not created/configured).

vpc_id.description: ID of the VPC created for this environment.

alb_arn.description: ARN of the Application Load Balancer.

alb_arn_suffix.description: ARN suffix of the ALB, used as a CloudWatch metric dimension (e.g. by the monitoring module).

alb_dns_name.description: Public DNS name of the Application Load Balancer.

ami_id.description: AMI ID resolved for the selected os_type.

autoscaling_group_name.description: Name of the Auto Scaling Group (used as a CloudWatch metric dimension by the monitoring module).

target_group_arn.description: ARN of the ALB target group.

target_group_arn_suffix.description: ARN suffix of the target group, used as a CloudWatch metric dimension.

app_port.description: Port the application/instances listen on, targeted by the ALB target group.

app_security_group_id.description: Security group ID attached to instances (from the security module).

associate_public_ip.description: Whether launched instances get a public IP. Should be true when instance_subnet_ids are public subnets (no NAT Gateway), false when they are private subnets behind a NAT Gateway.

certificate_arn.description: ACM certificate ARN for the HTTPS listener. Required when enable_https_listener = true.

enable_deletion_protection.description: Whether to enable deletion protection on the ALB (recommended true for prod).

enable_https_listener.description: Whether to create an HTTPS (443) listener on the ALB. Requires certificate_arn.

health_check_grace_period.description: Seconds the ASG waits after an instance launches before treating a failed ELB health check as a real failure.

iam_instance_profile_name.description: IAM instance profile name to attach (from the iam module's ec2_instance_profile_name output). Leave null to launch without one.

instance_subnet_ids.description: Subnets where Auto Scaling Group instances launch. Pass public subnets when the networking module's enable_nat_gateway = false (instances need a public IP to reach the internet for package installs / SSM); pass private subnets when a NAT Gateway is enabled.

instance_type.description: EC2 instance type. t3.micro is AWS free-tier-eligible and the default for this lab-scale project.

key_name.description: EC2 key pair name for SSH/RDP access. Leave null to rely on SSM Session Manager only (recommended — avoids distributing/rotating key material).

name_prefix.description: Prefix used for naming all compute resources.

os_type.description: "linux" (Amazon Linux 2023) or "windows" (Windows Server 2022) — selects the AMI and default user_data.

public_subnet_ids.description: Public subnets for the Application Load Balancer (needs at least 2, different AZs).

root_volume_size_gb.description: Root EBS volume size in GB.

tags.description: Extra tags merged into every resource created by this module.

user_data.description: Override the default user_data script. Leave null to use this module's minimal smoke-test web server (installs+starts a basic HTTP server so the ALB health check has something to pass against).

vpc_id.description: VPC ID the ALB and target group belong to.

web_security_group_id.description: Security group ID attached to the ALB (from the security module).

address.description: Hostname of the RDS instance, without the port (use with the `port` output when the two are needed separately).

db_name.description: Name of the initial database created on the instance.

db_subnet_group_name.description: Name of the DB subnet group created for this instance.

endpoint.description: Connection endpoint (host:port) of the RDS instance.

master_user_secret_arn.description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the auto-generated master password (null unless manage_master_user_password = true).

port.description: Port the RDS instance listens on.

username.description: Master username configured on the instance.

apply_immediately.description: Whether modifications apply immediately instead of during the next maintenance window. true is convenient for a lab; set false in prod to avoid unplanned downtime.

db_name.description: Initial database name created on the instance.

deletion_protection.description: Whether to enable RDS deletion protection (recommended true for prod).

instance_class.description: RDS instance class. db.t3.micro is AWS free-tier-eligible and the default for this lab-scale project.

manage_master_user_password.description: Let AWS generate and store the master password in Secrets Manager instead of a Terraform-managed plaintext variable (avoids ever writing a password into state or a .tfvars file). Strongly recommended true.

max_allocated_storage.description: Storage autoscaling ceiling in GB. Set to 0 to disable storage autoscaling.

multi_az.description: Enable synchronous Multi-AZ standby failover. Roughly doubles RDS cost. Off by default (dev/staging); recommended on for prod.

name_prefix.description: Prefix used for naming database resources.

skip_final_snapshot.description: true = terraform destroy leaves no final snapshot (fast/cheap, used in dev/lab so the environment can be torn down freely). Set to false for staging/prod so a snapshot survives destroy — final_snapshot_identifier is then required and generated automatically.

storage_encrypted.description: Whether to encrypt storage at rest with the default AWS-managed KMS key.

subnet_ids.description: Private subnet IDs for the DB subnet group (needs at least 2, different AZs).

tags.description: Extra tags merged into every resource created by this module.

vpc_security_group_ids.description: Security group IDs attached to the RDS instance (typically the db security group from the security module).

ec2_instance_profile_name.description: Name of the EC2 instance profile, to attach to a Launch Template (null if create_ec2_role = false).

ec2_role_arn.description: ARN of the EC2 instance role (null if create_ec2_role = false).

ec2_role_name.description: Name of the EC2 instance role (null if create_ec2_role = false).

github_actions_role_arn.description: ARN of the role GitHub Actions assumes via OIDC (use as role-to-assume in aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials).

github_oidc_provider_arn.description: ARN of the GitHub Actions OIDC provider in use (created by this module or the existing one passed in).

create_ec2_role.description: Whether to create the EC2 instance role/profile.

create_github_oidc_provider.description: Whether to create the GitHub Actions OIDC provider (token.actions.githubusercontent.com). AWS allows only one OIDC provider per URL per account — if it already exists (e.g. created by another environment's apply), set this to false and pass its ARN via existing_github_oidc_provider_arn.

ec2_managed_policy_arns.description: Extra AWS managed policy ARNs attached to the EC2 role in addition to the least-privilege inline CloudWatch policy this module creates. Defaults to AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore so instances can be reached via SSM Session Manager instead of opening SSH/RDP.

existing_github_oidc_provider_arn.description: ARN of an already-existing GitHub OIDC provider. Only used when create_github_oidc_provider = false.

github_allowed_branches.description: Git refs allowed to assume the GitHub Actions role via OIDC, e.g. ["ref:refs/heads/main"]. Use ["*"] to allow any ref (not recommended).

github_org.description: GitHub organization or user that owns the repository allowed to assume the GitHub Actions role.

github_repo.description: GitHub repository name allowed to assume the GitHub Actions role.

name_prefix.description: Prefix used for naming all IAM resources.

state_bucket_arn.description: ARN of the S3 bucket used for Terraform remote state, granted read/write to the GitHub Actions role. Leave empty to skip (role is still created, just without state permissions).

state_lock_table_arn.description: ARN of the DynamoDB table used for Terraform state locking, granted to the GitHub Actions role.

tags.description: Extra tags merged into every resource created by this module.

alb_alarm_names.description: Names of the ALB alarms created (empty when enable_alb_alarms = false).

ec2_alarm_names.description: Names of the EC2/ASG alarms created (empty when enable_ec2_alarms = false).

log_group_arns.description: ARNs of the CloudWatch log groups created by this module.

log_group_names.description: Names of the CloudWatch log groups created by this module.

rds_alarm_names.description: Names of the RDS alarms created (empty when enable_rds_alarms = false).

sns_topic_arn.description: ARN of the SNS topic alarms notify (this module's own topic, the externally-passed one, or null when neither is set).

alarm_description.constant_value: One or more targets behind the load balancer are unhealthy.
One or more instances in the Auto Scaling Group are failing an EC2 status check.

alarm_email.description: Email address subscribed to the SNS topic when create_sns_topic = true. Leave empty to create the topic without a subscription (subscribe manually later).

alb_5xx_threshold.description: Number of ALB-generated 5xx responses in a single period that triggers the alarm.

alb_arn_suffix.description: ARN suffix of the Application Load Balancer (from the compute module's alb_arn_suffix output). Required when enable_alb_alarms = true.

autoscaling_group_name.description: Auto Scaling Group name to monitor (from the compute module's autoscaling_group_name output). Required when enable_ec2_alarms = true.

cpu_alarm_evaluation_periods.description: Number of consecutive periods CPU must breach the threshold before the alarm fires.

cpu_alarm_period_seconds.description: Length, in seconds, of each CloudWatch evaluation period for the CPU alarm.

cpu_high_threshold.description: Average CPU utilization percentage that triggers the high-CPU alarm.

create_sns_topic.description: Whether to create an SNS topic that CloudWatch alarms publish to. Set false and pass sns_topic_arn instead to reuse an existing topic. Leave both false/empty to create alarms with no action (dashboard-only).

db_cpu_high_threshold.description: Average CPU utilization percentage that triggers the RDS high-CPU alarm.

db_free_storage_threshold_bytes.description: Free storage space, in bytes, below which the RDS low-storage alarm fires. Default is 2 GiB.

db_instance_id.description: RDS instance identifier to monitor (from the database module's db_instance_id output). Required when enable_rds_alarms = true.

enable_alb_alarms.description: Whether to create ALB 5xx and unhealthy-host-count alarms. Requires alb_arn_suffix and target_group_arn_suffix.

enable_ec2_alarms.description: Whether to create the EC2/ASG CPU and status-check alarms. Requires autoscaling_group_name.

enable_rds_alarms.description: Whether to create RDS CPU and free-storage alarms. Requires db_instance_id.

log_group_names.description: Application/system log group names to create (e.g. ["/enterprise-cloud-automation/dev/app"]). Empty by default — pass explicit names per environment.

log_retention_days.description: Retention, in days, for every log group created by this module. 0 = never expire.

name_prefix.description: Prefix used for naming all monitoring resources.

sns_topic_arn.description: Existing SNS topic ARN to notify on alarm state changes. Ignored when create_sns_topic = true (this module's own topic is used instead). Leave empty for no notifications.

tags.description: Extra tags merged into every resource created by this module.

target_group_arn_suffix.description: ARN suffix of the ALB target group (from the compute module's target_group_arn_suffix output). Required when enable_alb_alarms = true.

nat_gateway_ids.description: IDs of the NAT Gateways created (empty list when enable_nat_gateway = false).

private_route_table_ids.description: IDs of the private route tables, one per AZ.

private_subnet_ids.description: IDs of the private subnets, one per AZ.

public_route_table_id.description: ID of the public route table.

public_subnet_ids.description: IDs of the public subnets, one per AZ.

vpc_cidr_block.description: CIDR block of the created VPC.

azs.description: Availability zones to spread subnets across. Needs at least 2 entries for the ALB and RDS subnet group to be valid.

enable_nat_gateway.description: Whether to create a NAT Gateway (+ Elastic IP) so private-subnet resources can reach the internet. Defaults to false to avoid the ~$0.045/hour + data processing cost of a NAT Gateway sitting idle in a portfolio/lab environment. Enable it only when something actually needs to run in a private subnet with outbound internet access.

name_prefix.description: Prefix used for naming all networking resources (e.g. "enterprise-cloud-automation-dev").

private_subnet_cidrs.description: CIDR blocks for private subnets, one per AZ (same order as var.azs).

public_subnet_cidrs.description: CIDR blocks for public subnets, one per AZ (same order as var.azs).

single_nat_gateway.description: When enable_nat_gateway is true: true = one shared NAT Gateway for all AZs (cheaper, single point of failure — fine for dev/staging), false = one NAT Gateway per AZ (higher availability, higher cost — recommended for prod).

tags.description: Extra tags merged into every resource created by this module. The mandatory tags (Environment/Project/ManagedBy/Owner/CostCenter) are normally already applied via the provider's default_tags — use this for module-specific extras only.

instance_type.description: EC2 instance type for the Auto Scaling Group. t3.micro is free-tier-eligible — kept small in dev on purpose.

key_name.description: EC2 key pair name for SSH/RDP access. Leave null to rely on SSM Session Manager only.

min_size.description: Auto Scaling Group minimum size. Single instance in dev — no redundancy needed for a lab environment.

os_type.description: "linux" or "windows" — selects the AMI family and user_data used by the compute module.

owner.description: Owner tag value — who is responsible for this environment's resources.

private_subnet_cidrs.description: CIDR blocks for private subnets (one per AZ, same order as var.azs).

project_name.description: Short, stable project identifier used to name and tag every resource.

public_subnet_cidrs.description: CIDR blocks for public subnets (one per AZ, same order as var.azs).
